manual_notes: Metadata-first creation, typed editor validation, source/output metadata and panel controls have real implementation. The required source-query nonduplication is contradicted by the reviewed phase-2 code: each output stores source.srql_query in its own panel, and the final pinned show module executes panel.srql_query independently for every panel. Metadata stores the query again. The added test verifies only one output and explicitly asserts both copies. Strict completion of reusable-query scope is not supported despite checked tasks. Exact-path source records have identical specification Markdown; shared evidence is applied only after that comparison.

observed_facts: Implements metadata-first save and schema-guided/typed panel editing rather than raw JSON controls.
Adds explicit availability binding/shape validation and regression tests for unsupported combinations.
SourceQueries.panel_attrs_from_output copies srql_query into each output panel while source metadata also stores it; test asserts panel.srql_query and source.srql_query are both the source text.
Mount/reload Map.new(panels) invokes preview_panel_query for every panel; that function substitutes variables into panel.srql_query and executes it, without resolving a shared source-query execution.

limitations: No project tests were independently run.
ServiceRadar source SHAs have differed from available GitHub history; evidence uses explicitly named recovered public commits, not an assumption that original links still resolve.
Date is a reviewed code-integration evidence event, not independently established earliest completion.
review_depth: Read complete specification and related task packet; inspected implementation/test evidence described in sources.
